parameters.content:
## Instagram Integration (lightweight handler)
Verifies Meta webhook, resolves `instagramAccountId → chatbotId`, handles **Message Echoes** (`is_echo: true`) without AI reply, upserts **ChatSession**, calls **Core AI Brain**, then sends reply via IG Graph API.

### Setup
1. Open **Execute Core AI Brain** and select the imported *Core-AI-Brain* workflow.
2. Verify Token: `driplare_n8n_instagram_secret_2026`.
3. Integration.config holds `instagramAccountId`, `connectionSource`, and either
   `instagramAccessToken` (instagram_login) or `pageId` + `pageAccessToken` (facebook_login).
4. **Is Message Echo** guard filters out messages sent by merchant from Meta Business Suite and logs them directly to DB without triggering AI.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  i."integrationId",
  c."chatbotId",
  i."connected",
  i."status",
  i.config->>'connectionSource' AS "connectionSource",
  i.config->>'pageId' AS "pageId",
  i.config->>'instagramAccountId' AS "instagramAccountId"
FROM "chatbot"."Integration" i
JOIN "chatbot"."Chatbot" c ON i."chatbotId" = c."chatbotId"
WHERE i.platform = 'instagram'
  AND i."connected" = true
  AND i.config->>'instagramAccountId' = '{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.instagramAccountId }}'
LIMIT 1;

WITH inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO "chatbot"."ChatMessage" ("id", "chatbotId", "sessionId", "userId", "role", "sentByHuman", "content", "mediaUrl", "mediaType", "timestamp")
  SELECT
    'cm_' || md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text),
    '{{ $('Fetch Integration Secrets').item.json.chatbotId }}',
    '{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.sessionId }}',
    (SELECT "userId" FROM "chatbot"."Chatbot" WHERE "chatbotId" = '{{ $('Fetch Integration Secrets').item.json.chatbotId }}' LIMIT 1),
    'assistant',
    true,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF('{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.userMessage.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ''),
      '{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.mediaUrl.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
      CASE WHEN '{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.mediaType }}' = 'image' THEN '[Image]' ELSE '[Audio]' END
    ),
    NULLIF('{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.mediaUrl.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ''),
    NULLIF('{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.mediaType }}', 'text'),
    NOW()
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    -- One row per outbound message, whoever sent it:
    --   • sentByHuman = true  — the Live Inbox API already wrote this send;
    --   • sentByHuman = false — the AI's own reply, written by Core AI Brain.
    -- Meta echoes every Send API call back. Without the second branch an AI
    -- reply appeared twice (once as AI, once as "human") and the session was
    -- wrongly paused. Content is matched first so a genuine human reply sent
    -- shortly after an AI reply is still logged.
    SELECT 1 FROM "chatbot"."ChatMessage"
    WHERE "chatbotId" = '{{ $('Fetch Integration Secrets').item.json.chatbotId }}'
      AND "sessionId" = '{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.sessionId }}'
      AND "role" = 'assistant'
      AND "timestamp" > NOW() - INTERVAL '60 seconds'
      AND (
        "sentByHuman" = true
        OR (
          "sentByHuman" = false
          AND (
            "content" = COALESCE(
              NULLIF('{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.userMessage.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ''),
              '{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.mediaUrl.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
              CASE WHEN '{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.mediaType }}' = 'image' THEN '[Image]' ELSE '[Audio]' END
            )
            OR "timestamp" > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 seconds'
          )
        )
      )
  )
  RETURNING 1
)
UPDATE "chatbot"."ChatSession"
SET
  "lastMessage" = CASE
    WHEN '{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.mediaType }}' = 'image' THEN '📷 Sent an image'
    WHEN '{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.mediaType }}' = 'audio' THEN '🎵 Sent an audio'
    ELSE '{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.userMessage.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
  END,
  "updatedAt" = NOW()
WHERE
  "chatbotId" = '{{ $('Fetch Integration Secrets').item.json.chatbotId }}'
  AND "sessionId" = '{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.sessionId }}'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted);

INSERT INTO "chatbot"."ChatSession" ("id", "chatbotId", "sessionId", "platform", "guestName", "profilePhoto", "createdAt", "updatedAt")
VALUES (
  'cs_' || md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text),
  '{{ $json._upsert.chatbotId }}',
  '{{ $json._upsert.sessionId }}',
  'instagram',
  '{{ $json._upsert.guestName }}',
  NULLIF('{{ $json._upsert.profilePhoto }}', ''),
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT ("chatbotId", "sessionId")
DO UPDATE SET
  "guestName"    = EXCLUDED."guestName",
  "profilePhoto" = COALESCE(EXCLUDED."profilePhoto", "chatbot"."ChatSession"."profilePhoto"),
  "updatedAt"    = NOW();

parameters.query: UPDATE "chatbot"."ChatMessage" SET "platformMessageId" = NULLIF('{{ $('Send Instagram Text').item.json.message_id || '' }}', '') WHERE "id" = (SELECT "id" FROM "chatbot"."ChatMessage" WHERE "chatbotId" = '{{ $('Fetch Integration Secrets').item.json.chatbotId }}' AND "sessionId" = '{{ $('Normalize Instagram Payload').item.json.sessionId }}' AND "role" = 'assistant' AND "sentByHuman" = false AND "platformMessageId" IS NULL ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 1) AND NULLIF('{{ $('Send Instagram Text').item.json.message_id || '' }}', '') IS NOT NULL;
